Lessons.Title: Sums and Differences of Fractions
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will represent and solve problems involving the addition and subtraction of fractions.
In this lesson, you apply what you know about equivalence and addition and subtraction of fractions to solve problems. Throughout the lesson, you have opportunities to reason quantitatively and abstractly as you connect your representations, including equations, to the situations (MP2) and to compare your reasoning with others' (MP3).

2021 source activity sequence: Warm-up: Number Talk: Wholes and Units (10 minutes); Activity 1: Straws for A Roller Coaster (15 minutes); Activity 2: Tall Enough for a Ride? (20 minutes); Cool-down: The Flagpole (5 minutes)
Math focus: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators by first expressing lengths as equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Worked Edulytics example: One straw part is 7/12 foot, another is 1/4 foot. Rewrite 1/4 as 3/12. Add 7/12 + 3/12 = 10/12 = 5/6 foot.
First-party Edulytics Cool-down (publisher's original not inspected): Find 7/8 − 1/4 foot and give an equivalent simplest fraction.
Original models, source figures, student-authored problems and teacher-scored explanations require separate academic review.
